name: Cloud Account & Infrastructure Lifecycle
description: Create, register, baseline and retire accounts and infrastructure.

capabilities.name: Cloud account onboarding
capabilities.summary: Connect accounts with a cross-account IAM role (AssumeRole + external ID) or the instance role; connection test.

capabilities.name: Account provisioning
capabilities.summary: New member accounts through AWS Organizations (aws-account component). Needs the management account and a live apply.

capabilities.name: Account registration
capabilities.summary: Registered accounts are stored, tested and selectable per user.

capabilities.name: Environment creation
capabilities.summary: Wizard creates VPC + security baseline as one reviewed change.

capabilities.name: Region and availability zone management
capabilities.summary: Region and AZ picker; real AZs and zone IDs per account in live mode, built-in list in simulation.

capabilities.name: VPC and networking
capabilities.summary: CIDR planner, overlap check per account, NAT none/single/per-AZ, flow logs, S3 endpoint, locked default SG.

capabilities.name: Compute provisioning
capabilities.summary: EC2 with IMDSv2, encrypted gp3, Session Manager role, dedicated security group.

capabilities.name: Storage provisioning
capabilities.summary: S3 bucket, S3 static website (CloudFront or website endpoint), EFS.

capabilities.name: Kubernetes infrastructure
capabilities.summary: EKS with private API, KMS secrets, audit logs, managed node group, core add-ons.

capabilities.name: Load balancing
capabilities.summary: ALB with HTTPS redirect and TLS 1.3 policy.

capabilities.name: DNS and certificates
capabilities.summary: Route 53 zones and ACM certificates with automatic DNS validation.

capabilities.name: Infrastructure decommissioning
capabilities.summary: Remove one resource or a whole environment; destroys run in dependency order after approval.
